records.description_rewritten: Grunewald is a large Berlin forest with many separate cruising entries. The gay-szene page for this candidate specifies Pappelplatz beside S-Bahnhof Grunewald, a tree-nursery car park and nearby former sports field—not the separate named locations at Jagen 87, Jagen 90, or Teufelssee. A 4 August 2026 first-person report describes visiting by the Pappelplatz side, noticing men walking there on weekday days but little concrete activity and no personal encounter. Directory claims about crowd and leather are undated and cannot override that modest visitor evidence.

extra_sources.note: Original named Pappelplatz listing and dated August 2026 visitor post.
Another directory mentions broad Grunewald, but not necessarily this precise Pappelplatz zone.
Splashd city archive has Grunewald area card, not independent visitor verification.
